SELECT
    date_format(t1.BEGIN_TRADING_DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `起始日期`,
    date_format(t1.END_TRADING_DAY, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `结束日期`,
    t2.FUND_NAME AS `基金名称`,
    t2.FUND_SYMBOL AS `基金代码`,
    round(
        (
            (t3.RESTORED_ACCU_NAV / NULLIF(t4.RESTORED_ACCU_NAV, 0)) - 1
        ) * 100,
        2
    ) AS `近一年收益率(%)`,
    t3.RESTORED_ACCU_NAV AS `期末复权累计净值`,
    t4.RESTORED_ACCU_NAV AS `期初复权累计净值`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        MIN(CAL_DATE) AS BEGIN_TRADING_DAY,
        MAX(CAL_DATE) AS END_TRADING_DAY
    FROM analytics_master_data.REF_EDM_CALENDAR
    WHERE CAL_HCODE = 'CAL0001'
      AND HISVALID = 1
      AND IS_TRADEDATE = 1
      AND CAL_DATE >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-02', INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
      AND CAL_DATE <= '2026-09-02'
) t1
JOIN (
    SELECT
        FUND_NAME,
        FUND_SYMBOL
    FROM FUND_NETVALUE
    WHERE FUND_SYMBOL LIKE '%518880%'
    GROUP BY FUND_NAME, FUND_SYMBOL
    LIMIT 1
) t2 ON 1 = 1
LEFT JOIN FUND_NETVALUE t3
    ON t3.FUND_SYMBOL = t2.FUND_SYMBOL
    AND t3.TRADING_DAY = t1.END_TRADING_DAY
    AND t3.HISVALID = 1
LEFT JOIN FUND_NETVALUE t4
    ON t4.FUND_SYMBOL = t2.FUND_SYMBOL
    AND t4.TRADING_DAY = t1.BEGIN_TRADING_DAY
    AND t4.HISVALID = 1
WHERE t3.RESTORED_ACCU_NAV IS NOT NULL AND t4.RESTORED_ACCU_NAV IS NOT NULL
